candidate: position-build then release confirmed failed-sweep MSS

selection_protocol.exclusion: reject prior development/evaluation weeks and any candidate whose nine-day clock/context source interval overlaps a prior seven-day evaluation
selection_protocol.method: rank remaining Mondays by SHA-256(seed:date), then retain the first three mutually non-overlapping weeks before execution
selection_protocol.opening_rule: week 2 opens only after week 1 full_pass or promising_but_not_complete; week 3 opens only after week 2 also advances
selection_protocol.ablation_rule: if week 1 primary stops, run the frozen v23 MSS control on the identical week and union-plan TradeTick stream; remove only official OI build-release confirmation
selection_protocol.long_evaluation_rule: no long evaluation until all three frozen primary weeks advance without logic or parameter changes

frozen_source_scenario.representation: daily causal equal-notional event bars calibrated only from the immediately preceding completed UTC day
frozen_source_scenario.failed_sweep: 40-bp intrinsic same-side pivot sweep, confirmation back inside, initiative/reversal aggressive-flow sign change
frozen_source_scenario.mss: completed event close through the nearer opposing pivot with aggressive flow aligned to the reversal
frozen_source_scenario.entry: NautilusTrader market bracket on the first official venue TradeTick strictly after completed MSS
frozen_source_scenario.invalidation: adverse extreme of every completed failed-sweep-to-MSS event plus one 7-bp side-cost buffer
frozen_source_scenario.target: nearest active unconsumed completed UTC-day or completed Monday-Sunday week high/low strictly beyond the farther local opposing pivot

new_positioning_variable.data: official Binance Vision USD-M BTCUSDT metrics sum_open_interest
new_positioning_variable.causal_availability: each timestamped row is unavailable until five further wall-clock minutes have completed
new_positioning_variable.build: the latest causally available OI observation at failed-sweep arming is strictly above its immediately preceding observation
new_positioning_variable.release: a strictly later causally available OI observation by MSS is strictly below the sweep observation
new_positioning_variable.direction: the frozen failed-sweep aggressive-flow sequence determines direction; OI is used only to distinguish position creation and later release
new_positioning_variable.threshold_policy: strict sign and event order only; no fitted OI magnitude, percentile, ratio, session or volatility threshold

execution_contract.execution_data: official Binance Vision aggregate trades converted one-for-one to TradeTick
